skill.name: image-to-3d
skill.description: Convert an owned input image into a hosted GLB or textured 3D mesh through the Image Skill runtime. The skill provides guide, generation, install, recovery, receipt, and feedback commands for agent workflows.
skill.summary: Create hosted GLB-style 3D assets from owned images with Image Skill.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick hits are Markdown formatting, but several examples do instruct agents to run unpinned npx commands, install skills, and change agent home state. The skill depends on a hosted API and paid media workflow, so users need explicit consent before uploads, spending, or service-returned command execution. No prompt injection language was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin npm package versions or document trusted package provenance before asking agents to run npx commands.

remediation.issue: Service-returned commands can be executed by agents
remediation.suggestion: Require visible user approval and allowlist expected executables and arguments before running data.next_command values.

remediation.issue: Hidden agent profile paths are modified
remediation.suggestion: Avoid changing HOME or CODEX_HOME during normal use, or clearly scope changes to a temporary workspace directory.

remediation.issue: Hosted uploads and paid media generation
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit consent before uploading images, creating hosted assets, or using credit-bearing generation commands.

content.value_statement: Teams often need quick 3D assets from existing images without configuring model providers or local runtimes. This skill guides agents through Image Skill commands for hosted image-to-3D generation, receipts, recovery, and feedback.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to create hosted 3D mesh assets from one owned input image.
Provides a no-spend guide command before paid generation is attempted.
Shows the Image Skill edit workflow for the fal.trellis-image-to-3d model.
Lists hosted skill, LLM, CLI, and API contract URLs.
Includes install commands for the image-to-3d intent skill and canonical Image Skill.
References job recovery, asset URLs, cost receipts, JSON output, and feedback.
limitations: Requires access to the external Image Skill hosted service and npm tooling.
Generated mesh quality depends on the input image and selected hosted model.
Paid generation may spend credits when the user approves a creation command.
The skill cannot verify image ownership, privacy status, or downstream license needs.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Models
use_cases.description: Turn a product photo into a hosted GLB-style asset for early design review.

use_cases.title: Create Game Placeholder Assets
use_cases.description: Generate quick textured mesh candidates from concept images for prototype scenes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Ecommerce Previews
use_cases.description: Create inspectable 3D assets from approved catalog images for web preview experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Start With A Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with approval before spending.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the image-to-3d skill on this owned image. Start with the no-spend guide and ask before any paid generation.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Web Preview Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a product or catalog preview.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this product image into a hosted GLB-style asset for web preview. Return the asset link, cost receipt, and inspection notes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Asset Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the 3D asset, inspect the result, and summarize geometry, texture, scale, and cleanup needs before I use it.

prompt_templates.title: Recover Or Report A Workflow Gap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced recovery or provider gap handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether Image Skill can recover this job or support this image-to-3D request. If it cannot, prepare feedback with the missing capability.

output_examples.input: A clean product photo of a ceramic mug needs a web-ready 3D preview.
output_examples.output: A hosted 3D asset link, a cost receipt, and notes about handle shape, texture quality, and review steps.

output_examples.input: A concept image should become a quick placeholder mesh for a prototype scene.
output_examples.output: A textured mesh candidate with hosted access, generation details, and warnings about scale and cleanup needs.

output_examples.input: A previous image-to-3D run needs to be recovered for another agent.
output_examples.output: A recovered job reference, asset URL, receipt summary, and any available feedback or retry guidance.

best_practices: Confirm image rights and upload permission before using the hosted service.
Start with the guide flow and request approval before paid generation.
Save asset links, receipts, model names, and inspection notes with the project.
anti_patterns: Run service-returned commands without checking the command and spend fields.
Upload private, regulated, or third-party images without clear approval.
Assume generated meshes are production-ready without visual inspection.

faq.question: Does this require local 3D software?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses the hosted Image Skill runtime instead of a local model server.

faq.question: What output format is emphasized?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on hosted 3D mesh assets such as GLB-style outputs.

faq.question: Can this workflow spend money?
faq.answer: Yes. Paid generation can use credits, so agents should ask before running creation commands.

faq.question: Does it need provider API keys?
faq.answer: No provider keys are required. The hosted runtime handles provider access through Image Skill.

faq.question: Is it safe for private images?
faq.answer: Use caution. Images may be uploaded to a hosted service, so private data needs explicit approval.

faq.question: What happens if the model cannot support the request?
faq.answer: The skill asks agents to use a fallback only for the gap and submit feedback about the missing capability.
